title: Wooly

description.en: Keep family perks in sight: card rewards, memberships, insurance, and expiry dates.
description.zh: 把家庭的信用卡权益、会员、保险福利和到期时间放在眼前。

websiteSource: Owner-confirmed Docker/jp2 deployment, 2026-09-12; public /api/live (never /login) verified in docs/sources/status-targets-2026-09-12.json
subject: Sheep portrait

source.description: Family perks dashboard — credit card rewards, insurance benefits, expiry alerts

subject.en: Cream faceted sheep with three curls, a wink, and a pink tongue
subject.zh: 奶油色碎片绵羊，保留三缕卷毛、眨眼和粉色舌头

description.en: A portrait viewfinder catches the same wink and tongue as broad, natural fleece enters from below. The curls and ears have room inside the rounded frame.
description.zh: 取景框捕捉熟悉的眨眼和吐舌，宽厚而自然的羊毛从下方进入画面。卷毛和耳朵在圆角内保留充分余量。

description.en: Connected ivory and oat facets preserve the bright sheep identity. The tongue remains its single playful gesture; the pale anatomy stays opaque after extraction.
description.zh: 连续的象牙白与燕麦色面保持绵羊的明亮形象，舌头仍是单一俏皮动作，抠图后浅色身体保持不透明。

description.en: The selected deeper rose field keeps its uneven scalloped folds, fine grain, and shallow shadows. The background stays separate from the transparent animal.
description.zh: 沿用较深玫瑰底色、不均匀的云状褶皱、细颗粒与浅阴影，背景和透明动物独立保存。

palette.source: Selected Wooly presentation, 2026-09-07-02/01; background.base in archived settings.json

sizeNote.en: At 32 px, the cream ears, dark eye, and pink tongue carry the identity. The wink and tiny fleece facets simplify at 16 px; sidebar and browser marks use the transparent foreground.
sizeNote.zh: 32 像素时，奶油色耳朵、深色眼睛和粉色舌头构成识别重点；16 像素时眨眼与细小羊毛切面会简化，侧栏和浏览器使用透明前景。

goal.en: Keep household benefit accounts, usage cycles and redemption records together so family members can check remaining allowances, expiry and points.
goal.zh: 集中记录家庭权益账户、使用周期与核销记录，方便核对剩余额度、到期时间和积分。

role.en: Web pages and server-side data proxy
role.zh: Web 页面与服务端数据代理
数据集 API 与校验

role.en: Models, ViewModels, routes and Worker tests
role.zh: 模型、视图模型、路由和 Worker 测试

description.en: Large, uneven scallops gather into open folds, carrying the sheep’s soft curls into the margins.
description.zh: 大小不一的圆弧聚成开放褶线，把绵羊柔软的卷毛延伸到页边。

alt.en: Cream faceted sheep with three curls, a wink, and a pink tongue on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: 奶油色碎片绵羊，保留三缕卷毛、眨眼和粉色舌头，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

caption.en: Keep the good things in sight.
caption.zh: 让家人的权益和期限一目了然。

description.en: Cream faceted sheep with three curls, a wink, and a pink tongue.
description.zh: 奶油色碎片绵羊，保留三缕卷毛、眨眼和粉色舌头。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Keep the existing portrait's natural frame entry. The full square is placed against the baseline; no anatomy is extended, trimmed or masked. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留原头像自然入框的边界，将完整方形画布贴齐基线；不补画、不截取解剖结构。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥63px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 63px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
